title: 封裝聲學顯微檢測
summary: 以四階段、24 步深入聲阻抗、飛行時間與 C-SAM 界面圖；每個技術單元分為建模與證據驗證，包含可重算的教學算例、失效辨識及相關工法。
summaryEn: Four stages and 24 steps examine acoustic impedance, time of flight and c-sam interface maps. Each technical unit separates modeling from evidence validation, with reproducible teaching examples, failure diagnosis and related methods.
scope: 公開資料支持的原理與工程判讀課；24 步是學習拆解，不是工廠完整 SOP。數值均為明示假設的教學例；實際材料、設備、驗收門檻須依專案規格。影像亮度取決於閘門、頻率與相位；暗區或亮區不具有普遍固定的缺陷含義，水耦合亦需評估樣品相容性。
scopeEn: A principles and engineering-interpretation course grounded in public material. The 24 steps are an educational decomposition, not a complete factory SOP. Numbers are labeled hypothetical; actual materials, equipment and acceptance limits require project specifications. Brightness depends on gate, frequency and phase; bright/dark regions have no universal defect meaning, and water coupling requires sample compatibility.
